name: Spaghetti with Roasted Bacon, Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Wash, dry, and quarter mushrooms. Add to the baking sheets with the Brussels sprouts.
Small dice bacon and add to the baking sheets. Drizzle with oil and maple syrup, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices bacon
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and bacon is cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the pasta is done, reserve 1 cup of cooking water, then drain. Return pasta and reserved cooking water to the pot; set aside until the veggies are done.

Add roasted veggies, bacon, Parmesan, and Dijon to the pot, then set over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring often, until the liquid has evaporated and Parmesan has melted, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
